overview_description.description:
The #1 Crowdfunding Marketing & PR Agency since 2010, with the most $1,000,000+ Kickstarter & Indiegogo Campaigns of any agency in history, with our first record-breaking campaign in 2010. 

From design, to copy-writing, to pre-launch, to advertising, to public relations, to retail placement from over 500+ campaigns created from the ground up.  

Agency 2.0's consistency of results and track record boil down to experience and our 200+ step proprietary crowdfunding marketing strategy that has been developed, optimized and expanded over the course of nearly a decade.
